title: Lane reads harness options without h.mu while setters write them from other goroutines
observed: go test -race with Retier looping during Lane.Prompt reports data races at internal/harness/turn.go:160 (opSettings reads l.h.opts.Compaction) and turn.go:645/685 (buildStreamOptions copies l.h.opts). SetCompactionSettings, SetToolOutputTokens, AddTools and SetSystemPrompt write under h.mu from /model, MCP connect and mods. Predates PR #55.
expected: The turn loop takes a locked snapshot of the options it reads, so a concurrent setter never races a request being built.

fix.note: The turn loop reads settable options (Tools, SystemPrompt, Compaction) through h.mu: requestOptions snapshots, CompactionSettings, SystemPrompt and toolSet; stallLimits takes a pointer so it no longer copies the struct.
